name: Love In Sync
description: A former top actress who has lost her ability to feel and a psychological counselor who feels too much are brought together through a mysterious ability to share emotions. As she begins to rediscover emotions through him, and he learns to manage the overwhelming weight of empathy through her, the two gradually heal each other in unexpected ways.

videos.title: First Encounter
videos.overview: Yu Ji-an is an actress with a lot of fans thanks to her pretty face, but she is not the kind of actress who acts well. She feels she is losing her popularity to her rival, Han Yi-jin. Hence, she is advised to get psychological counselling from a famous counsellor, Cha Eun-hwan, to get a hint to improve her acting skills from her subconscious. But at their first meeting, an unexpected incident happens.

videos.title: Ji-an’s Downfall
videos.overview: After Ji-an feels panic at Eun-hwan’s clinic, she experiences a weird phenomenon, where she can listen to a man’s voice out of nowhere. Meanwhile, Ji-an meets Moon Gyeong -sik, a famous movie director, and gets cast in his movie, which is a huge opportunity for her. However, the emergence of her bullying video makes her popularity plummet, ruining her bright future.

videos.title: Attempt To Comeback
videos.overview: After moving to the small house compared to her previous villa, she realises that Eun-hwan is living across the hall and meets his daughter, Ha-yul. Ji-an struggles to make a comeback despite her collapsed reputation in the industry, and she gets a golden chance to audition. Meanwhile, Eun-hwan is frustrated by his guilt over his client’s arrest, so he tries to meet the victim of the crime.

videos.title: Proposal To Eun-hwan
videos.overview: Finally, Ji-an feels sure that Eun-hwan’s emotions are transferred to her. She receives praise for her acting because she can finally understand other people’s emotions, thanks to transference from Eun-hwan. Hence, she suggests that Eun-hwan be her manager and help her immerse herself in acting. Meanwhile, Eun-hwan’s situation is getting worse because he rejects the therapist position at J.An Entertainment and has to close his clinic because of the disciplinary action from the Association. Will he accept Ji-an’s proposal?

videos.title: New Manager
videos.overview: After Eun-hwan accepts Ji-an’s proposal to be her manager, they start practising their collaboration for the acting so they don't make mistakes during the shoot. However, when the shooting starts, Ji-an is flustered upon realising that the emotional transference no longer works, and she is fired from the show. Hence, Eun-hwan tries to cheer her up by enhancing her reputation, and they try to figure out why the emotional transference is not working.

videos.title: Audition
videos.overview: Ji-an and Eun-hwan guess that the reason why the emotional transference is reversed is the earlier kiss. So they try to kiss every hour in different places. After the emotional transference is reversed again, Ji-an passes on an audition and gets a role in Director Moon’s film. Also, Eun-hwan tries to find Mi-jeong, who accused Ji-an, and tries to find out the truth of the power abuse case from her.
